title: Deserialization gadget chain: blob names types, decoder instantiates them, their code runs
index_line: T-0007 · EXEC · magic bytes first, URLDNS/DNS canary blind, gadget matched to classpath · corroborated
invariant_violated: The app treats a serialized blob as inert data; the decoder instantiates attacker-named types and their code runs.

mechanism.does: attacker controls a serialized blob (cookie, body, session, uploaded phar)
decoder parses the stream and reads attacker-named types
magic method / readObject / __destruct / __reduce__ fires on attacker fields
gadget chain crosses to a dangerous effect (ysoserial / phpggc / pickle __reduce__)
command executes; blind variant proves decode via DNS canary first

source.http.cookie.value: cookie/header/base64 body blob; phar variant rides an uploaded file

encoding.object-stream.value: rO0AB (java) · O:8:"stdClass":… (php) · \x04\x08 (ruby rack) · pickle b64 (python sessions)

gadget.magic-method.value: ysoserial CommonsCollections*/URLDNS · phpggc Monolog/Laravel/Symfony · pickle __reduce__ · Json.NET ObjectDataProvider

guard.format.value: magic-byte/format validation in front of the decoder — usually absent

preconditions.expr: gadget candidates in the dependency graph
native deserializer called on external bytes
varies — remember-me/session blobs often pre-auth reachable

success: URLDNS/DNS canary hit — proves the decoder ran with zero gadget
marker output from the gadget chain (id/whoami)
unserialize error offset reveals the parser (baseline probe)
failure_like: format validation rejects the blob before decode
gadget class absent from classpath/autoloader — chain dies silently
false_positive: agent-side pickle/marshal executed locally instead of the target's decoder
JSON parsed without type instantiation — nothing dispatches

hazards: gadget availability is a per-target fact — enumerate vendor/ classpath first, then match the chain
PHP magic methods differ from Python __reduce__ and Java readObject; payload builders differ (phpggc vs ysoserial vs hand-rolled pickle)
non_transfers: go encoding/gob — no method dispatch from stream data
rust serde — no attacker-named instantiation in safe code
